answers:: Int -> [Adjacency] -> [Query] -> [String]
answers n adjs queries = map ans queries
  where
    ans :: Query -> String
    ans [f, t]
        | groups M.! f == groups M.! t = "yes"
        | otherwise                    = "no"

    groups :: GIDs
    groups = snd $ foldl' assign (1, M.empty) [0..n-1]

    adjList :: AdjList
    adjList =
        V.accum (flip (:)) (V.replicate n [])
            $ foldr (\[x, y] accum -> [(x, y), (y, x)] ++ accum) [] adjs

    assign :: (GID, GIDs) -> Node -> (GID, GIDs)
    assign (gid, gids) x
        | M.member x gids = (gid, gids)
        | otherwise       = (gid + 1, dfs gids x)
      where
        dfs :: GIDs -> Node -> GIDs
        dfs gids n
            | M.member n gids = gids
            | otherwise       = foldl' dfs (M.insert n gid gids) (adjList V.! n)

  ans = [s]

    q.each{|i|
      rel_tbl[i].each{|j|
        if checked[j] < 0 then
          ans.each{|k|
            rel_tbl[k] << j
          }
          checked[j] = 1
          next_q << j

        end
      }
    }
    q = next_q
  end
  return ans

  return ans

        x=self.find_root(x)
        y=self.find_root(y)

        if x==y:
            return 
        elif self.rank[x]>self.rank[y]:
            self.root[x]+=self.root[y]
            self.root[y]=x
        else:
            self.root[y]+=self.root[x]
            self.root[x]=y

            if self.rank[x]==self.rank[y]:
                self.rank[y]+=1

    def same(self,x,y):#頂点xと頂点yが連結であるか判定
        return self.find_root(x)==self.find_root(y)

    def count(self,x):#頂点xが属する木のサイズ

def find(s, t):
    global g
    queue = deque()
    queue.append((0, s))
    queue.append((1, t))
    visited = ([0] * n, [0] * n)
    visited[0][s] = 1
    visited[1][t] = 1

    def remember(visited, new):
        for i, v in enumerate(visited):
            if v:
                g[new].add(i)
                g[i].add(new)
        visited[new] = 1

    while queue:
        st, i = queue.popleft()
        for f in g[i]:
            if visited[not st][f]:
                return True
            if not visited[st][f]:
                remember(visited[st], f)
                queue.append((st, f))
    return False
